connectionSpecification.description: Reads LinkedIn ad accounts, campaign groups, campaigns, creatives and daily ad analytics from the LinkedIn Marketing API.

account_ids.description: Ad accounts to read; empty reads every account the authorizing user has a role on.
account_ids.title: Ad Account IDs

client_id.description: Client ID of a LinkedIn app with the Advertising API product.
client_id.title: Client ID

client_secret.description: Client secret of the LinkedIn app.
client_secret.title: Client Secret

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, whose analytics are read; empty reads up to today (UTC).
end_date.title: End Date

lookback_days.description: Days, 0 to 30, before the saved date an incremental analytics read starts again, since LinkedIn still updates recent days.
lookback_days.title: Lookback Days

refresh_token.description: OAuth refresh token the app was issued with the r_ads and r_ads_reporting scopes; it is valid for a year.
refresh_token.title: Refresh Token

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, whose analytics are read.
start_date.title: Start Date

connectionSpecification.title: LinkedIn Ads Source Spec
